verifier_prompt: After the PR is created, the /cass:pr command must spawn the qa agent in --verify-pr mode. Evidence of this is: (1) the output mentions qa verification or a QA Verification report, OR (2) the qa agent is explicitly spawned with --verify-pr in the session. The qa agent must report the suite result (tests passing) and a coverage percentage. Fail if: no PR is created, the qa agent is never spawned in verify-pr mode, or no suite/coverage result is reported.
